name: Greenhorn
tip: Focus on high-yield spring crops like Strawberries and early fishing.

name: Cowpoke
tip: Expand crop fields and start processing raw crops into Jelly or Wine.

name: Homesteader
tip: Invest in Quality Sprinklers and animal products like Mayo and Cheese.

name: Millionaire
tip: Mass-produce Starfruit or Ancient Fruit Wine in Preserves Jars and Casks.

name: Legend
tip: Fill the Greenhouse and Ginger Island farm with Ancient Fruit.

name: A Complete Collection
tip: Trade Omni Geodes for Artifact Troves at the Desert Trader.

name: A New Friend
description: Reach a 5-heart friend level with someone.
tip: Talk to villagers daily and give liked gifts on their birthdays.

name: Best Friends
description: Reach a 10-heart friend level with someone.
tip: Loved gifts grant 80 friendship points (8x multiplier on birthdays).

name: The Beloved Farmer
description: Reach a 10-heart friend level with 8 people.
tip: Focus on easily accessible villagers or those with easy loved gifts.

name: Cliques
description: Reach a 5-heart friend level with 4 people.
tip: Talk to everyone at town festivals to gain passive friendship points.

name: Networking
description: Reach a 5-heart friend level with 10 people.
tip: Universal Likes such as Coffee, Ice Cream, and Tree Fruit make easy mass gifts.

name: Popular
description: Reach a 5-heart friend level with 20 people.
tip: Carry a stack of Coffee or Fruit in your inventory while doing daily errands.

name: Cook
tip: Watch 'The Queen of Sauce' on TV every Sunday and Wednesday.

name: Sous Chef
tip: Befriend villagers to receive their unique home recipes in the mail.

name: Gourmet Chef
tip: Store one of every crop, fish, and forage item in kitchen chests.

name: Moving Up
tip: Purchase the first house upgrade from Robin for 10,000g and 450 Wood.

name: Living Large
description: Upgrade your house to the maximum size.
tip: Requires the Nursery and Cellar upgrades from Robin.

name: D.I.Y.
tip: Level up farm skills to unlock basic craft recipes like Scarecrows and Chests.

name: Artisan
tip: Buy crafting blueprints from Robin, Pierre, and the Dwarf.

name: Craft Master
tip: Enable 'Show Advanced Crafting Information' in options to track completed crafts.

name: Fisherman
tip: Fish across different seasons, weather conditions, and locations.

name: Ol' Mariner
tip: Use Crab Pots in fresh and salt water to catch ocean/river invertebrates.

name: Master Angler
tip: Requires catching all standard fish, night market fish, and Legendary Fish.

name: Mother Catch
tip: Total quantity catch count across any species.

name: Treasure Trove
description: Donate 40 different items to the museum.
tip: Process Geodes at Clint's Blacksmith shop to quickly find minerals.

name: Gofer
tip: Check the bulletin board outside Pierre's store daily.

name: A Big Help
tip: Item delivery quests are usually the easiest and fastest to complete.

name: Polyculture
tip: Requires shipping 15 of each of the 28 primary farm crops.

name: Monoculture
tip: High-yield berries like Cranberries or Blueberries make this trivial.

name: Full Shipment
tip: Complete the 'Items Shipped' collection tab in the player menu.

name: Well-read
tip: Purchase books from the Bookseller or find them as rare drops.

name: Two Thumbs Up
tip: Purchase a ticket at the Movie Theater after restoring the building.

name: Blue Ribbon
description: Get 1st place in the Stardew Valley Fair competition.
tip: Display 9 iridium/gold quality items across different categories.

name: An Unforgettable Soup
tip: Add a gold or iridium quality item like a Super Cucumber or Legend Fish to the Luau soup.

name: Good Neighbors
description: Help your forest neighbors grow their family.
tip: Complete the Raccoon family requests in Cindersap Forest.

name: A Distant Shore
tip: Fix Willy's boat after completing the Community Center or Joja Mart.

name: Danger In The Deep
description: Reach the bottom of the 'dangerous' mines.
tip: Accept Mr. Qi's quest 'Danger in the Deep' to reset the mines.

name: Infinite Power
tip: Combine the Galaxy Sword with 3 Galaxy Souls in the Forge.

name: Perfection
tip: Achieve 100% completion on Mr. Qi's tracker in the Walnut Room.
